summary: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that JDEP Coffee B.V. (successor to JDE Peet's) has guaranteed Maple Notes and KDP's credit facilities, and that KDP and its subsidiaries have guaranteed JDEP's debt. This cross-guarantee arrangement supports the prior acquisition of JDE Peet's, completed on April 1, 2026. The guarantees will terminate automatically upon a previously announced separation of KDP's coffee and beverage businesses. No new transaction or event triggering a special-situation classification is present; the filing is a routine update on debt guarantees related to a prior acquisition.
